summary: 23:30 review: Pittsburgh 27, Syracuse 13 is final. The original score forecast is evaluated below; all watched markets remained observations, with no official CFB ticket to settle.
takeaways: Final: Pittsburgh 27, Syracuse 13. The frozen September 14 baseline was Pittsburgh 32, Syracuse 19: correct winner, 1-point margin error and an 11-point overprediction of total scoring. This evaluates the score forecast, not a betting win.

Syracuse used both Steve Angeli and Amari Odom, and running-back carries were shared among Ahmad Miller, Shavane Anderson Jr. and Ju'Juan Johnson. Check subsequent team reports before treating this as an injury, a permanent quarterback change or a stable lead-back role.

One game is not enough to retune the model or claim a new defensive pattern. Keep workload, efficiency and scoring errors separate. Conflicting player yardage remains flagged for a morning source check.

Friday morning priorities: Miami at Wake Forest (7:30 p.m. ET), Houston at Texas Tech (8 p.m.) and Portland State at Oregon (10:30 p.m.). Start with current availability, offensive lines and direct FanDuel/DraftKings prices; these are research assignments, not picks.
